name: Heavily Damaged Jaws of Hell
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-06: Brastlewark at War Part 1: The Gnome Defection
description: The machine is a cylindrical device ringed in blades with a devilish eye at its center. Gnome inventors created the mechanical device, which taps into the planes of earth and fre to create powerful blasts to damage fortress walls or decimate ranks of enemies. Unfortunately, the many miles of forest have not been kind and it's malfunctioning. The damaged jaws planar connections have weakened to a mere trickle and, when activated, it lashes out in an uncontrolled frenzy. The blades encircling it begin lashing out.
disable: DC 15 Arcana , DC 15 Crafting , DC 15 Nature , or DC 15 Thievery (trained) twice, to sever the connection to the planes of fre and earth. DC 13 Crafting or DC 13 Thievery (trained) once, to remove the pintle connecting the limber to the horses. A creature must be adjacent to the jaws to make either check.
reset: The planar connection shuts down after 1 minute. The horses will tire and stop running after 1 minute.
routine: (three actions) On its turn each round, the horses spend one action to move 30 feet, dragging the limber carrying the jaws behind them in a randomly chosen direction. The horses will not move through other creatures. Players on the limber when it moves must attempt a DC 15 Acrobatics check when it moves or fall of. Removing the pintle will end the random movement. The jaws use 2 actions to Spit Fire or make melee strikes against an adjacent creature.

defensiveAbilities.name: Blades of Vengeance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature, moves within 10 feet of the jaws.

Effect One of the blades lashes out, making one Strike against the creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spit Fire
offensiveAbilities.description:
The jaws launch a magma ball (range 60 feet, 10ft Burst), randomly, at the largest group of creatures, not including itself, it can catch in the blast dealing 2d4 Bludgeoning Damage|options:area-damage] damage. Each creature caught in the blast must attempt a DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save. The jaws cannot Spit Fire again for 1d4+1 #recharge spit fire rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, 1 Persistent,fire Damage damage, and is knocked prone.
